"generate_image": generate_image (native-service)

Gateway model service generate_image:
Generate a new image or edit up to three attached reference images. Use only when a newly generated or edited image is the requested deliverable, not for analyzing attachments. Pass the relevant uploaded image paths in ImagePaths for editing or reference-guided generation; attachment IDs are also accepted when no path is provided. Call this tool alone, without other tools in the same response. The image is delivered automatically once.
